shot_config.default_rate_denominator: completed loans (Fully Paid + Charged Off); 'Current' loans excluded
shot_config.net_return_definition: (total_pymnt - funded_amnt) / funded_amnt on completed loans, not annualised

shot_queries.default_by_grade: SELECT grade, loans, default_rate_pct, avg_int_rate_pct, net_return_pct FROM a_default_by_grade ORDER BY grade_rank
shot_queries.default_by_purpose_top5: SELECT purpose, loans, default_rate_pct FROM a_default_by_purpose ORDER BY default_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 5
shot_queries.default_by_income: SELECT income_band, loans, default_rate_pct FROM a_default_by_income ORDER BY income_band
shot_queries.default_by_dti: SELECT dti_band, loans, default_rate_pct FROM a_default_by_dti ORDER BY dti_band
shot_queries.default_by_term: SELECT value AS term, loans, default_rate_pct FROM a_default_by_profile WHERE attribute = 'term' ORDER BY value
